topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I found it, the mark of someone’s hand on my skin—my work, etched as if it belonged elsewhere, on someone else’s canvas. The lines, so familiar, now twist in a different form, a different life. It’s strange, seeing this, my art, now part of them. Did they ask, or just take? I can’t tell. Each stroke, a whisper of who I am, now carved into someone’s story. I want to reach out, to touch, to maybe understand. But I stand here, in the quiet, wondering what it all means now, changed in a way that feels... permanent.
